facts.fact: 丈夫熟睡时，我在巫刻（witching hour）赤脚溜下楼去收获运气
facts.quote: The best time to harvest luck was none other than the witching hour.

facts.fact: 我们的房子有三层楼，内部由我亲自设计、最好的工匠定制建造
facts.quote: The interior was custom built by the best craftsmen, all three floors

facts.fact: 两个 Peculiars（影子生物）从楼梯扶手上溜到我脚边，我叫出它们的名字 Absinthe 和 Tonic
facts.quote: “Hello, Absinthe,” I whispered. A pinch at my other ankle. “I didn’t forget you, Tonic.”

facts.fact: Absinthe 和 Tonic 的名字来自母亲的铅玻璃酒瓶——我童年时曾把它们囚在卧室里，如今也不知它们如何找到我
facts.quote: my mother’s leaded glass decanters that I’d imprisoned them inside

facts.fact: 活着的人里没人像我一样懂 Peculiars：多数人根本看不见它们，能看见的就算异类
facts.quote: Most people couldn’t even see them. As I understood it, you were an anomaly if you could.

facts.fact: 我在书房让 Absinthe 和 Tonic 融合成黑油般的液池，念唤词 Florescentia 把手臂伸进去召唤彼界
facts.quote: “Florescentia.” The welcoming of the void with a single word.

facts.fact: 我往后拉手臂时，一股墨质触须缠紧我的手腕，皮肤被勒得发红，随后其他形体从池中爬上我的双腿
facts.quote: around my wrist a thick tendril of ink tightened, reddening the skin as it gripped.

facts.fact: 这只强壮的 Peculiar 以触须进入并抚遍我的敏感处，用性爱式的仪式交换幸运（Lust for luck），我最终达到高潮完成仪式
